title: Constraint: Uniform by Bit Count
constraints: `v` is 8 bits. Its **number of set bits** (0 … 8) must be uniformly distributed: each count roughly 1/9 of the time over 900 calls (every bin between 60 and 145).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Uniform over *values* gives a binomial bit-count distribution: 70 of the 256 values have 4 ones, only 1 has 0 ones.
Pick the count first, then constrain `$countones(v) == k`.

By the LRM, `rand int k` with `solve k before v;` would do it, but Verilator doesn't honor `solve…before` for the distribution. Drawing `k` yourself in `pre_randomize()` (`k = $urandom_range(0, 8);`, with `k` a non-rand member) works on every simulator.
